title: Samsung DV6000 dryer — Smart Install entry
description: Adjust Time Up + Temp 7 s → SC; touch sensor and motor/heater diagnosis.

steps.title: Enter Smart Install
steps.body: Press and hold Adjust Time Up + Temp for 7 seconds until SC displays.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and hold Adjust Time Up + Temp for 7 seconds until SC displays.

steps.title: Touch sensor test
steps.body: Open door — 0=open, 1=short. Wet cloth on sensor shows 1.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open door — 0=open, 1=short. Wet cloth on sensor shows 1.

steps.title: Motor and heater test
steps.body: Press Start — OK = motor and heater normal; HC = fault.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Start — OK = motor and heater normal; HC = fault.
